_comment: Situation -> short coaching-note templates, authored from the book corpus (backend/data/coach/corpus.jsonl). Rules are matched in order; the FIRST rule whose every 'when' feature equals the live feature wins. Features are booleans/strings precomputed in ui/coach_notes.py. Templates are str.format'd with live values (system ranges, vulnerability, the actual visible/inferable cards) — no citations, ~<=45 words.

rules.template: {hcp} HCP — too strong for one of a suit. Open {strong_call}, your system's strong artificial force, then describe. {vuln_clause}
Balanced {hcp} — open 2NT ({nt2_min}-{nt2_max} in {system}). One bid limits the hand; partner takes over with Stayman/transfers.
Balanced {hcp} — a textbook 1NT ({nt_min}-{nt_max} in {system}). It limits your hand in one bid; let partner place the contract.
{hcp} HCP, {long_n}-card {long_suit} — a weak two/preempt ({wk_min}-{wk_max}). Bid to the level of your trumps. {vuln_clause}
{hcp} HCP with {long_n} {long_suit} — open 1{long_suit_char} (5-card majors). Show the major first; plenty to open.
{hcp} HCP, no 5-card major — open your better minor and hunt for a major fit on the way up.
Only {hcp} HCP and nothing long — pass. Don't open sub-minimum; you can still compete later if it's your hand.
Hold up {holdup_suit}A — Rule of 7: duck {holdup_n}, exhausting {danger_seat} of the suit before you give up the lead.
No-trump: count sure winners, then knock out stoppers to set up {long_suit} ({long_n} together) — build before you cash, mind your entries.
Don't draw the last trump — an opponent holds the master {trump_sym}. Keep control, take your tricks, concede the trump at the end.
Draw trumps first — {danger_seat} is void in {threat} and waiting to ruff. {finesse}
Count losers, then ask: draw trumps? {out} out ({split}). Plan ruffs/finesses before touching trumps, then run {long_suit}. {finesse}
Defending NT: attack your longest suit (fourth-best), hold up your stopper, and count declarer's tricks. You need {set_target} to beat it.
Defending {trump_sym}: go active — cash or set up winners before they're pitched; lead a trump if a cross-ruff looms. {set_target} tricks beats it.
